headline: UP GARAGE GROUP launches self-tender offer for treasury shares at 10% discount to market price.

Offer price 1,197 yen, a 10% discount to the 1,330 yen six-month average closing price as of 2026-11-05.
Parent company E&E holds 5,664,300 shares (71.40%) and intends to sell 800,000 shares (10.08%) for cash.
Announcement date 2026-11-06; filing submitted 2026-11-09 to the Kanto Local Finance Bureau.
Purchase funds to be entirely covered by own funds; the filing states 14 billion yen of liquidity expected at settlement start.
stated_purpose: To acquire treasury shares through a tender offer, as E&E, the majority shareholder and parent company, intends to sell 800,000 shares to convert them to cash. The company states the purchase is expected to contribute to improved EPS and ROE, return profits to shareholders, and be a more favorable option than market purchases or ToSTNeT-3 because the tender offer allows a discounted price. The company also states the tender offer provides equal opportunity for minority shareholders and limits the outflow of company assets.
